newsitem.title: FRANCE: French capital markets closing report.
newsitem.headline: French capital markets closing report.

text.p: French bond futures settled just marginally in the red after market-positive U.S. producer price data in the afternoon buoyed the U.S. market and pulled French debt out of its early morning retreat.

Traders said that short covering in the wake of the U.S. PPI figures and buying in the cash market lifted the French market in a busy MATIF session in which the March 10-year bond future settled at 130.74 after a morning low of 130.46.

Signals were, however, remain clouded as the market tries to guage the liklihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike on March 25, making U.S. consumer price data next Wednesday a big figure to watch, traders said.
